name: The Royal Kanchipuram Brocade Silk Saree with Traditional Hand-Woven Golden Thread Border and Exquisite Floral Motifs
description: An exceptional structural masterpiece represents the highest echelons of South Indian weaving. This saree represents three weeks of unceasing, mathematically precise manual loom configuration. Woven with double-warp threads of heavy mulberry silk from Mysore, it achieves a high-density, crisp silk drape that holds shape flawlessly. Every individual border motif represents traditional Dravidian temple friezes and mythical lions (Yali), meticulously jointed using the traditional Petni technique which welds the contrasting vermilion border directly into the deep brass-gold body threads. The heavy zari pallu showcases a breathtaking tapestry of traditional paisley vines, floral baskets, and geometric diamond grids woven with pure silver thread dipped in solid 22-carat gold bath. Ideal for weddings, high-end bridal contexts, and multi-generational heritage collections. Unmatched in quality, thickness, and longevity.
